verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Convertio offers an API, a CLI, and cloud-side conversion. These are developer building blocks a user could script into automations. Nothing documents a product-native feature for setting up recurring, triggered, or autonomous background automations such as schedules, watch folders, or workflows. Cloud processing of individually submitted jobs is a one-off action, not an autonomous recurring automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
